title: Changelog hero sprites for onboarding flow (annotated before/after screenshots)
creator: Ivy Chen
description: Create a compact, reusable image pack for the upcoming changelog blog and quickstart docs that includes: 1) hero sprites and CTA overlays for the blog header (desktop/mobile), 2) annotated before/after UI screenshots showing the new onboarding flow and quickstart callouts, and 3) export-ready assets in multiple densities and formats. Goal: provide marketing and docs teams with plug-and-play visuals that match Redwood visual system and are accessible across channels.
acceptance_criteria: Hero header image (desktop) exported as PNG@2x and WebP with text-safe area and overlay CTA variant
Mobile hero sprite (stacked) exported as SVG and optimized PNG@2x
Three annotated before/after screenshot pairs (desktop, tablet, mobile) with callout labels, arrows, and short microcopy
Design tokens used for callout color, border, and shadow documented in a short README
All assets uploaded to Drive + linked Figma file + example usage snippets for blog and docs
Accessibility notes: contrast checks for callouts, alt text suggestions for each asset
updates: 2026-03-05: Kickoff — scoped hero and screenshot variants with PM (Sofia Patel) and Content (Marco Alvarez). Decided to prioritize compact hero for blog and expanded screenshots for docs.
2026-03-07: Explorations done — two visual directions (glass panel vs. color-block) captured in Figma. Preference toward color-block for brand parity.
2026-03-09: First pass delivered to PM for review; requested stronger emphasis on CTA contrast and smaller copy for mobile.
2026-03-11: Engineering reviewer (Marcus Nguyen) flagged potential screenshot cropping issues for embedded docs; added export guidance for max widths and safe area overlays.
2026-03-12: Design review meeting — agreed on final tokens, annotation style, and export naming convention. Preparing final exports and README for handoff. Status set to In Review.
comments: Sofia Patel (PM) — please add a version with the new 'Try Redwood' CTA (primary) and a muted secondary action for docs landing.
Marco Alvarez (Content) — microcopy suggestions: change 'Start in 2 minutes' to 'Get started in minutes' for better localization.
Marcus Nguyen (Eng) — noted that some product screens are behind feature flags; we should include placeholder state guidance for screenshots taken in prod vs. staging.
Design Lead (Audrey Kim) — approved visual direction; requested asset README and export checklist before finalizing.
deliverables: SVG callout sprite sheet and individual PNG fallbacks
README with usage examples, alt text, contrast checks, and export checklist
Example markdown snippet for blog and docs showing how to include responsive assets
notes_for_engineering: Provide a small script in docs repo to reference assets with responsive srcset
If screenshots are taken from staging, include a small label overlay (Staging) and provide clean prod placeholders
Ensure exported PNGs are optimized (zopfli/oxipng) and WebP available for blog CDN
next_steps: Finalize exports and upload to Drive by 2026-03-14
Create README and usage snippets and attach to PR
Ask Docs team to confirm one sample blog post with the hero asset
Close ticket once PR is merged and assets are consumed in docs repo
